title: ganglion module manifest
description: What a WASM module needs and may do (spec 7.5, ADR-0011, ADR-0012). The Go loader runner.ParseManifest is the validator; this schema is for editors, docs and the agent.

abi.description: The module ABI the module speaks (ADR-0011); missing means 1. A core refuses an ABI it does not support (ADR-0041).

triggers.description: When the module runs: on a cron schedule, as a tool the agent calls, when cells change, or when a browser asks the edge's loopback listener.

tool.description: Tool name: lower-case letters, digits and _; the node prefixes it with the module.

cell.description: Full ids of the cells whose change starts the module; each must be in cells.read and none is the module's own. One such trigger per manifest.

http.description: Routes the edge's loopback listener serves under http://<http.local_addr>/<module>/ (R-HTTP-1). One such trigger per manifest. A request starts the module with trigger http.

path.description: Absolute path inside the module's prefix: letters, digits and . _ ~ - /, at most 128 bytes, no dot or empty segment. Matched exactly.

about.description: What the tool does, for the agent.

output.description: The contract of the tool's answer; required for a tool of a local module.

capabilities.description: Host functions the module may use; anything not listed is denied.

state.description: May keep state in its KV store.

notify.description: May message the owner, at most per_day messages a day.

ports.description: The typed ends the module offers to links (R-BUS-5). A port name is lower-case letters, digits and _, starting with a letter, at most 32; it is unique across all four kinds and `notify` is reserved (a module with notify has the output notify, shape {text: string, at: string}). Local modules only.

emits.description: Events the module publishes, by port name, with the shape of the payload.

accepts.description: Events the module takes, by port name, with the shape of the payload.

serves.description: Calls the module answers, by port name.

calls.description: Calls the module makes, by port name.

cells.description: The cells the module reports and the ones it may read (ADR-0062).

report.description: Sensor cells the module owns, by short name; the cell id is <module>.<name>.

read.description: Full ids of cells the module may read.

config.description: The settings the module reads; the owner sets their values.

timeout.description: Per call, a Go duration like 20s.

about.description: What the cell holds, for the agent.

shape.description: A contract for a JSON value: a type name (number, integer, boolean, string; a trailing ? allows null), a list of strings (an enum), {list: <shape>} (an array) or a mapping of fields (an object; a field name is lower-case letters, digits and _, at most 32; one ending in ? may be missing, other fields are refused).
